purpose: Acquire, practice, evaluate, retain, and deploy professional creative-production intelligence without confusing tool access with artistic mastery.

layers.professional_knowledge: research-backed discipline vocabulary, workflows, failure modes, and source provenance
layers.tool_intelligence: versioned knowledge of installed tools, automation surfaces, strengths, and limitations
layers.practice: small controlled exercises with explicit questions, bounded scope, and before/after evidence
layers.artistic_judgment: perceptual, specialist, independent, and human review separated from structural validity

freeze_policy.allowed_return: bounded regression only; declare global capability, scope, expected lesson, evidence, and stop condition before touching fixture

first_global_proofs.before: ontology and skills implied capability; no machine-readable actual-state audit
first_global_proofs.after: every ontology entry receives a truth state and explicit evidence limitations

first_global_proofs.before: long missions could continue improving a calibration artifact after its lesson was extracted
first_global_proofs.after: frozen-fixture work without a bounded regression declaration returns STOP_AND_REPLAN

first_global_proofs.before: perceptual metrics were available but did not consistently block known creative failure patterns
first_global_proofs.after: known-bad visual evidence is classified separately from structural validity and cannot support POLISHED without review

known_limits: pattern detection is not semantic vision
model registry evidence is small and task rubrics are still shallow
creative quality requires actual image/video/audio evidence and independent or human review
professional mastery is not claimed for any broad creative production domain
